name: Winkin' Cow Bourbon Shake
ingredients_raw: DOUBLE TONED MILK, WATER, SUGAR, COCOA SOLIDS (1.4%), EMULSIFIERS & STABILIZERS (471, 412, 407, 415&418), BISCUIT (0.3%) [COLOURS (150, 1500, 122, 110, 133 & 102), RAISING AGENTS (500(ii) & 503), NATURE IDENTICAL & ARTIFICIAL VANILLA CHOCOLATE MILK&MILKY COCOA) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES AND EMULSIFIERS 1471 $220, FLAVOURS (NATURE IDENTICAL (CHOCOLATE) AND ARTIFICIAL (VANILLA) FLAVOURING ACIDITY REGULATORS (340(ii), 340 & 452(1) AND IODIZED SALT.
